breakdown.description: A transient heat equation is written while the problem is described as steady with no time dependence (equations/assumptions conflict).
breakdown.reason: The agent recognized the conflict between the transient equation and the steady-state description, but resolved it in the wrong direction compared to the ground truth. The ground truth resolves the inconsistency by treating the problem as transient (matching the equation dT/dt = α d²T/dx²) and adding initial conditions T(x,0) and boundary conditions. The generated specification instead kept the steady-state framing and dropped the time derivative, which does not match the ground truth's resolution.
